items.title: Obituary: Voice actor Eric Bauza has passed away at 46
items.summary: The voice behind Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, and a host of other well-loved characters has passed away suddenly at age 46.

items.title: "It was a pretty harrowing three months" – Undead Labs head Philip Holt on what happened after Xbox cut the studio loose
